newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aichi Tokei says FTC action may affect earnings.
newsitem.headline: Aichi Tokei says FTC action may affect earnings.

text.p: Aichi Tokei Denki Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its earnings for the 1997/98 business year may be affected by recent action taken against it by the Fair Trade Commission (FTC) over suspected bid-rigging.
The government's anti-monopoly watchdog filed a complaint on Tuesday with prosecutors against 25 firms including Aichi Tokei Denki, a water-gauge maker, over suspected bid-rigging.
The FTC said that the firms are suspected of prearranging winners of contracts for water gauges awarded by the Tokyo metropolitan government.

"We fear a considerable impact on our performance in the next business year and thereafter," the company said in a statement. But the company said it would do its best to avoid a decline in its business performance.
The company also said it would improve its surveillance to guard against improper business activities in the company.
